pacific-islands.title: Pacific ke Tapu
pacific-islands.description: Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu, New Caledonia, Palau, Micronesia, Marshall Islands, Nauru, Tuvalu aur Kiribati ke Gilbert Islands — Port Moresby, Suva, Nadi, Honiara, Port Vila, Nouméa aur Majuro.

south-central-us.title: America ke Dakkhin-Beech Rajya
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi aur Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson aur Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa aur Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, American Samoa, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, aur Wallis and Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi aur Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila aur Tonga ke tapu.

mariana-islands.title: Guam aur Northern Mariana Islands
mariana-islands.description: Guam aur Northern Mariana Islands — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian aur Rota.

greenland.title: Greenland
greenland.description: Greenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq aur Tasiilaq; barf ke chaadar, Ilulissat Icefjord aur dakkhin ke fjord.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s aur Royal Naval Dockyard, tapu ke parish aur uske gulaabi baalu waala beach.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno aur Brest; Belovezhskaya Pushcha ke jangal aur Polesia ke daldal.

channel-islands.title: Channel Islands
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark aur Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port aur Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Faroe Islands
faroe-islands.description: Faroe Islands — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík aur atharah tapu, uske gaon, surang aur samundar ke kinaare ke unche chattaan.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard aur Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg aur Ny-Ålesund; Spitsbergen ke glacier aur fjord.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo aur Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria aur Three Cities.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagascar aur Hind Mahasagar ke Tapu
madagascar-islands.description: Madagascar, Comoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Mauritius aur Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis aur Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid aur Nyala; jahaan Blue Nile aur White Nile mile hai, aur Meroë ke pyramid.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria aur das tapu, Santo Antão se Brava talak.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé aur Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé aur Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António aur dono tapu ke rainforest aur beach.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension aur Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, Ascension Island aur Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown aur Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet aur Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans aur Ganga–Brahmaputra delta.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka aur Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka aur Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura aur Malé; pahaari ilaaka, Sigiriya aur atoll.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An aur Can Tho; Ha Long Bay aur Mekong Delta.

philippines.title: Philippines
philippines.description: Philippines — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio aur Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao aur Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesia aur Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonesia aur Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar aur Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi aur Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysia, Singapore aur Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysia, Singapore aur Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching aur Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine aur Inle Lake; Irrawaddy ke ghaati aur Shan ke pahaar.

cambodia-laos.title: Cambodia aur Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Cambodia aur Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap aur Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang aur Pakse; Mekong nadi aur Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Colombia
colombia.description: Colombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena aur Bucaramanga; Andes, Caribbean ke kinaara aur Amazon.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida aur Ciudad Bolívar; Angel Falls, Orinoco nadi aur Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos aur Puno; Machu Picchu, Lake Titicaca aur Sacred Valley.

ecuador.title: Ecuador
ecuador.description: Ecuador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta aur Baños; Avenue of the Volcanoes, Amazon aur Galápagos Islands.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre aur Potosí; Lake Titicaca aur Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chile
chile.description: Chile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena aur Punta Arenas; Atacama, Lake District, Patagonia aur Easter Island.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay aur Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay aur Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este aur Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Guiana ke Desh
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname aur French Guiana — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne aur Kourou; Kaieteur Falls aur Guiana Shield ke rainforest.

falklands.title: Falkland Islands
falklands.description: Falkland Islands — Stanley, Goose Green aur East Falkland aur West Falkland ke tapu.

australia.title: Australia
australia.description: Australia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin aur Canberra; Great Barrier Reef, Uluru aur Outback.

new-zealand.title: New Zealand
new-zealand.description: New Zealand — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin aur Queenstown; Southern Alps, Fiordland aur Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George aur Whistler; Coast Mountains, Vancouver Island aur Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Canada ke Prairies
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan aur Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina aur Banff; Rockies, prairies aur Hudson Bay pe Churchill.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston aur Thunder Bay; Niagara Falls, Great Lakes aur Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke aur Saguenay; St. Lawrence nadi, Laurentians aur Gaspé Peninsula.

atlantic-canada.title: Atlantic Canada
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, aur Newfoundland and Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton aur Charlottetown; Cabot Trail aur Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Uttar Canada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories aur Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City aur Inuvik; Arctic Archipelago aur Mackenzie nadi.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong aur Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong aur Macau — Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau aur Macau Peninsula, Taipa aur Coloane.
